statement.title: L. The Camel Is Not Camelling

legend: While wandering through the desert, Ammar and his camel discover a sealed cave. A short chant opens the door, but there is still no water inside. Instead, Ammar finds the Bassami Water Puzzle.
The puzzle has an ordered box $$$v$$$. The box starts empty and can hold at most $$$m$$$ stones. Ammar then receives $$$n$$$ stones one by one.
The $$$i$$$-th stone is described by two values, $$$id_i$$$ and $$$state_i$$$:
$$$id_i$$$ is the identifier written on the stone;
$$$state_i=0$$$ means the stone is broken;
$$$state_i=1$$$ means the stone is unbroken.
The same identifier may appear more than once in the input. The box, however, never contains two stones with the same identifier.
For each incoming stone, apply the first rule below that matches the current box:
A stone with identifier $$$id_i$$$ is already in the box: remove that old stone from its current position, then put the incoming stone at the back of the box.
The box has fewer than $$$m$$$ stones: put the incoming stone at the back.
The box is full and contains at least one broken stone: remove the first broken stone, then put the incoming stone at the back.
The box is full, all stones in it are unbroken, and $$$state_i=1$$$: remove the first stone, then put the incoming stone at the back.
The box is full, all stones in it are unbroken, and $$$state_i=0$$$: ignore the incoming stone.
The first stone is the one closest to the front of the box. The back is the opposite end.
There are also $$$k$$$ curse moments. Immediately after processing the $$$c_j$$$-th stone for every $$$j$$$, the curse reverses the whole current order of the box.
After all stones and curses are handled, output the final contents of the box from front to back.
input: The first line contains one integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.

Each test case starts with a line containing three integers $$$n$$$, $$$m$$$, and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n,m \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$, $$$0 \le k \le n$$$) — the number of processed stones, the capacity of the box, and the number of curse moments.
Each of the next $$$n$$$ lines contains two integers $$$id_i$$$ and $$$state_i$$$ ($$$1 \le id_i \le 10^9$$$, $$$state_i \in \{0,1\}$$$) — the identifier and state of the $$$i$$$-th stone.

After the stones, for $$$k \gt 0$$$, one more line contains $$$k$$$ distinct integers $$$c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_k$$$ ($$$1 \le c_1  \lt  c_2  \lt  \ldots  \lt  c_k \le n$$$). These are the processing steps followed by a curse. For $$$k=0$$$, this line is not present.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, print two lines.
The first line contains one integer — the final number of stones in the box.
The second line contains the identifiers of the stones in the box from front to back, separated by spaces. For an empty box, print an empty second line.
note: In the first sample test case, the first three stones make the box $$$[1,2,3]$$$. The first curse reverses it to $$$[3,2,1]$$$.

Stone $$$4$$$ removes the first broken stone, so the box becomes $$$[2,1,4]$$$. Stone $$$5$$$ is unbroken; the full box has no broken stones, so the first stone is removed and the box becomes $$$[1,4,5]$$$. The second curse reverses it to $$$[5,4,1]$$$. Stone $$$6$$$ is broken, while the full box contains only unbroken stones, so stone $$$6$$$ is ignored.

legend: 在沙漠中游荡时，阿马尔和他的骆驼发现了一个封闭的洞穴。一声简短的呼喊打开了门，但里面仍然没有水。相反，Ammar找到了Bassami水拼图。
这个谜题有一个有序的盒子 $$$v$$$。盒子一开始是空的，最多只能容纳 $$$m$$$ 块石头。然后，阿马尔会一块一块地接收 $$$n$$$ 块石头。
第$$$i$$$块石头由$$$id_i$$$和$$$state_i$$$两个值描述：
$$$id_i$$$是写在石头上的标识符；
$$$state_i=0$$$ 意味着石头碎了;
$$$state_i=1$$$ 意味着这块石头完好无损。
同一个标识符可以在输入中出现多次。然而，盒子里从来没有两个具有相同标识符的石头。
对于每个进入的石头，应用以下第一个与当前盒子匹配的规则：
一个标识符为$$$id_i$$$的石头已经在盒子里了：把那个旧的石头从它当前的位置移开，然后把新石头放在盒子的后面。
盒子里的石头少于 $$$m$$$:将进来的石头放在盒子后面。
箱子是满的，里面至少有一块碎石头：把第一块碎石头移走，然后把后面来的石头放进去。
盒子已经满了，里面的所有石头都完好无损。$$$state_i=1$$$:取出第一块石头，然后将即将到来的石头放在后面。
箱子是满的，里面的石头都没有碎，$$$state_i=0$$$：忽略进来的石头。
第一块石头是离盒子正面最近的。背面是盒子的另一端。
处理完所有石头和诅咒后，从前到后输出盒子的最终内容。
input: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例都以包含三个整数$$$n$$$、$$$m$$$和$$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n,m \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$、$$$0 \le k \le n$$$）的一行开始——处理过的石头的数量、盒子的容量和诅咒时刻的数量。
接下来的 $$$n$$$ 行中的每一行都包含两个整数 $$$id_i$$$ 和 $$$state_i$$$($$$1 \le id_i \le 10^9$$$、$$$state_i \in \{0,1\}$$$)——即 $$$i$$$ 第三块石头的标识符和状态。
在石头之后，对于$$$k \gt 0$$$，再多一行包含$$$k$$$个不同的整数$$$c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_k$$$ ($$$1 \le c_1  \lt  c_2  \lt  \ldots  \lt  c_k \le n$$$）。这些是处理步骤之后的诅咒。对于$$$k=0$$$，这一行不存在。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$n$$$ 之和不超过 $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，打印两行。
第一行包含一个整数——盒子中的最终棋子数。
第二行包含盒子中石头的标识符，由空格分隔。对于空框，打印空的第二行。
note: 石头 $$$4$$$ 移除了第一块破碎的石头，因此盒子变成 $$$[2,1,4]$$$。石头 $$$5$$$ 未破碎;整个盒子没有破碎的石头，因此第一块石头被移除，盒子变成 $$$[1,4,5]$$$。第二个诅咒将其逆转为 $$$[5,4,1]$$$。石头 $$$6$$$ 破碎，而整个盒子只包含未破碎的石头，因此石头 $$$6$$$ 被忽略。

problems.hint: Consider $i$ in an increasing order. Adjust your answer.

legend: You may reorder the elements of $$$a$$$ arbitrarily. Let $$$b$$$ be the array obtained after reordering. The array $$$w$$$ is not reordered: $$$w_i$$$ always belongs to position $$$i$$$.

A position $$$i$$$ ($$$1 \le i \le n$$$) is called good if $$$b_i \le i$$$. The score of $$$b$$$ is the sum of weights of all good positions. In other words, for every good position $$$i$$$, add $$$w_i$$$ to the score.
Find the maximum possible score.
input: The first line contains one integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of a test case contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the length of the arrays.
The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$).
The third line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$w_1, w_2, \ldots, w_n$$$ ($$$0 \le w_i \le 10^9$$$).
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, print one integer — the maximum possible score.
note: In the first sample, one optimal reordered array is $$$b=[1,7,2,2,4]$$$. Positions $$$1$$$, $$$3$$$, $$$4$$$, and $$$5$$$ are good, so the score is $$$5+9+4+8=26$$$.  In the second sample, every element of $$$a$$$ is greater than every valid position index, so no position can be good and the answer is $$$0$$$.

legend: 您可以任意重新排序$$$a$$$的元素。设$$$b$$$为重新排序后得到的数组。数组$$$w$$$未重新排序：$$$w_i$$$始终属于位置$$$i$$$。
如果$$$b_i \le i$$$，则称$$$i$$$ ($$$1 \le i \le n$$$）为好位。$$$b$$$的得分是所有好位置的权重之和。换句话说，对于每一个好的位置$$$i$$$，将$$$w_i$$$加到分数中。
找到最大可能得分。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$）—测试用例的数量。
测试用例的第一行包含一个整数$$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$）—数组的长度。
保证所有测试用例的$$$n$$$总和不超过$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，打印一个整数——可能的最大得分。
note: 在第一个样本中，一个最优的重排序数组是$$$b=[1,7,2,2,4]$$$。位置$$$1$$$， $$$3$$$， $$$4$$$和$$$5$$$都很好，所以分数是$$$5+9+4+8=26$$$。在第二个样本中，$$$a$$$的每一个元素都大于每一个有效的位置指标，所以没有位置是好的，答案是$$$0$$$。

problems.hint: The element to minus is the XOR of the former elements. And there is an observation.

legend: You are given an array $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ and an integer $$$k$$$.

For every subarray $$$[l,r]$$$ ($$$1 \le l \le r \le n$$$), define $$$$$$ f(l,r)=\left[\sum_{i=l}^{r-1} a_i \oplus a_{i+1}\right]-a_l \oplus a_r $$$$$$ Here $$$\oplus$$$ denotes the bitwise XOR operation. If $$$l=r$$$, the sum is empty and is defined to be $$$0$$$.
Count the number of subarrays $$$[l,r]$$$ such that $$$f(l,r)=k$$$.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$, $$$0 \le k  \lt  2^{30}$$$) — the length of the array and the required value of $$$f(l,r)$$$.
The second line of each test case contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i  \lt  2^{30}$$$).
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, print one integer — the number of subarrays $$$[l,r]$$$ for which $$$f(l,r)=k$$$.
note: In the first test case, the only subarray is $$$[1,1]$$$. Both the empty sum and $$$a_1 \oplus a_1$$$ are zero, so its value is zero.

In the second test case, all three subarrays of length one and both subarrays of length two have value zero. The subarray $$$[1,3]$$$ has value $$$$$$ (1 \oplus 2)+(2 \oplus 3)-(1 \oplus 3)=3+1-2=2. $$$$$$ Therefore, the answer is $$$5$$$.

legend: 给定一个数组$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$和一个整数$$$k$$$。

对于每个 $$$[l,r]$$$($$$1 \le l \le r \le n$$$) 子数组，定义 $$$$$$ f(l,r)=\left[\sum_{i=l}^{r-1} a_i \oplus a_{i+1}\right]-a_l \oplus a_r $$$$$$ Here $$$\oplus$$$ denotes the bitwise XOR operation. If $$$ l=r$$$, the sum is empty and is defined to be $$$ 0$$$$。
input: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数$$$n$$$和$$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$, $$$0 \le k  \lt  2^{30}$$$）——数组的长度和所需的$$$f(l,r)$$$值。
每个测试用例的第二行包含$$$n$$$个整数$$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n$$$ ($$$0 \le a_i  \lt  2^{30}$$$）。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$n$$$ 之和不超过 $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，打印一个整数—子数组$$$[l,r]$$$的个数$$$f(l,r)=k$$$。
note: 在第一个测试用例中，唯一的子数组是$$$[1,1]$$$。空和和$$$a_1 \oplus a_1$$$均为零，因此其值为零。

problems.hint: Consider $p^\alpha$ .

legend: Shaban is moving from Earth to Mars, where the laws of physics are a little unusual.
On Earth, when several weights are placed on the same side of a balance scale, their weights are added together. For example, weights $$$2$$$ and $$$5$$$ have total weight $$$2 + 5 = 7$$$.
On Mars, however, weights are multiplied instead of added. Thus weights $$$2$$$ and $$$5$$$ have total weight $$$2 \cdot 5 = 10$$$.
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fa0b13b8cd52ff3d1171821438ca2d5f2cd72587.png)

Shaban wants to take a collection of balance weights with positive integer values to Mars. For every vegetable whose weight is an integer from $$$1$$$ to $$$m$$$, inclusive, he must be able to determine its exact weight by placing a non-empty subset of his weights on the empty side of the balance. On Mars, this means that the product of the chosen weights must be equal to the vegetable's weight.
Multiple carried weights may have the same value.
Your task is to find the minimum number of weights Shaban needs to take.
input: The first line contains one integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
Each test case begins with a line containing one integer $$$m$$$ ($$$1 \le m \le 10^6$$$).
output: For each test case, print one integer — the minimum number of weights Shaban needs to take so that every integer weight from $$$1$$$ to $$$m$$$ can be represented as the product of a non-empty subset of his weights.
note: For $$$m = 6$$$, one optimal collection is $$$\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$$$. The weight $$$1$$$ is necessary because the chosen subset must be non-empty. The weights $$$1$$$, $$$2$$$, $$$3$$$, $$$4$$$, and $$$5$$$ are represented directly, and $$$6 = 2 \cdot 3$$$.
For $$$m = 9$$$, one optimal collection is $$$\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9\}$$$. In particular, $$$8 = 2 \cdot 4$$$ and $$$9$$$ is represented directly.

legend: 沙班将从地球搬到火星，那里的物理定律有点不同寻常。
在地球上，当几个权重放在天平的同一侧时，它们的权重会相加。例如，权重 $$$2$$$ 和 $$$5$$$ 的总重量为 $$$2 + 5 = 7$$$。
然而，在火星上，重量是相乘而不是相加的。因此，权重$$$2$$$和$$$5$$$的总权重为$$$2 \cdot 5 = 10$$$。
Shaban想带一组正整数的平衡权值去火星。对于重量为$$$1$$$到$$$m$$$(包括在内）之间的整数的每一种蔬菜，他必须能够通过将其重量的非空子集放在天平的空一侧来确定其确切重量。在火星上，这意味着所选重量的乘积必须等于蔬菜的重量。
你的任务是找到Shaban需要承担的最小权重。
input: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例以包含一个整数$$$m$$$ ($$$1 \le m \le 10^6$$$）的一行开始。
output: 对于每个测试用例，打印一个整数—Shaban需要采用的最小权重数，以便从$$$1$$$到$$$m$$$的每个整数权重都可以表示为其权重的非空子集的乘积。

problems.hint: Each query can be de-composed.

legend: You are given a zero-indexed array $$$a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{n-1}$$$ of $$$n$$$ integers, each initially equal to $$$0$$$. You have to perform $$$q$$$ update operations on it. Each operation is described by four integers $$$l$$$, $$$r$$$, $$$x$$$, and $$$v$$$, and is performed as follows: for every $$$i$$$ with $$$l \le i \le r$$$, add $$$v$$$ to $$$a_{x \,\&\, i}$$$, where $$$\&$$$ denotes the bitwise AND operation.
Print the array $$$a$$$ after all $$$q$$$ operations are performed.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$q$$$ ($$$1 \le n, q \le 10^6$$$) — the size of the array and the number of operations.

Each of the next $$$q$$$ lines contains four integers $$$l$$$, $$$r$$$, $$$x$$$, and $$$v$$$ ($$$0 \le l \le r \le n - 1;$$$ $$$0 \le x \le n - 1;$$$ $$$1 \le v \le 10^6$$$) — the parameters of one operation.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$10^6$$$ and the sum of $$$q$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$10^6$$$.
output: For each test case, print $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{n-1}$$$ — the final array.
note: In the first test case, the array is initially $$$[0, 0, 0, 0]$$$.

The first operation has $$$l = 1$$$, $$$r = 3$$$, $$$x = 2$$$, $$$v = 5$$$. For $$$i = 1$$$: $$$2 \,\&\, 1 = 0$$$, so $$$5$$$ is added to $$$a_0$$$. For $$$i = 2$$$: $$$2 \,\&\, 2 = 2$$$, so $$$5$$$ is added to $$$a_2$$$. For $$$i = 3$$$: $$$2 \,\&\, 3 = 2$$$, so $$$5$$$ is added to $$$a_2$$$ again. Note that $$$a_2$$$ receives $$$v = 5$$$ twice during this single operation, once for $$$i = 2$$$ and once for $$$i = 3$$$. The array becomes $$$[5, 0, 10, 0]$$$.

legend: 给定一个由$$$n$$$个整数组成的零索引数组$$$a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{n-1}$$$，每个整数最初都等于$$$0$$$。你必须对它执行$$$q$$$更新操作。每个操作用四个整数$$$l$$$， $$$r$$$, $$$x$$$， $$$v$$$来描述，执行方法如下：对于每一个$$$i$$$和$$$l \le i \le r$$$，将$$$v$$$加到$$$a_{x \,\&\, i}$$$上，其中$$$\&$$$表示位与运算。
在执行所有 $$$q$$$ 操作后打印数组 $$$a$$$。
input: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数$$$n$$$和$$$q$$$ ($$$1 \le n, q \le 10^6$$$）——数组的大小和操作的数量。
接下来的 $$$q$$$ 行中的每一行都包含四个整数 $$$l$$$、$$$r$$$、$$$x$$$ 和 $$$v$$$($$$0 \le l \le r \le n - 1;$$$$$$0 \le x \le n - 1;$$$$$$1 \le v \le 10^6$$$)——即一次运算的参数。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$n$$$ 和不超过 $$$10^6$$$，所有测试用例的 $$$q$$$ 和不超过 $$$10^6$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，打印$$$n$$$个整数$$$a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_{n-1}$$$ -最终数组。
note: 在第一个测试用例中，数组最初为 $$$[0, 0, 0, 0]$$$。

problems.hint: Not a lot of cases.

legend: You are given a binary string $$$b$$$ of length $$$n$$$.
Construct a string $$$s$$$ of length $$$n$$$ consisting of lowercase English letters such that for each $$$i$$$ ($$$1 \le i \le n$$$):
if $$$b_i = 1$$$, then every substring$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$ of $$$s$$$ of length $$$i$$$ is a palindrome$$$^{\text{†}}$$$;
if $$$b_i = 0$$$, then at least one substring of $$$s$$$ of length $$$i$$$ is not a palindrome.
Print the lexicographically smallest$$$^{\text{‡}}$$$ such string $$$s$$$. If no such string exists, print $$$-1$$$.

$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$A string $$$x$$$ is a substring of a string $$$y$$$ if $$$x$$$ can be obtained from $$$y$$$ by the deletion of several (possibly, zero or all) characters from the beginning and several (possibly, zero or all) characters from the end. For example, bc, abc, and d are substrings of abcd, while ac and ba are not.

$$$^{\text{†}}$$$A string is a palindrome if it reads the same from left to right and from right to left. In other words, the reverse of the string is the same as the original string. For example, a, aba, and abba are palindromes, while ab and abc are not.

$$$^{\text{‡}}$$$String $$$x$$$ is lexicographically smaller than string $$$y$$$ if either $$$x$$$ is a proper prefix of $$$y$$$, or there exists a position $$$i$$$ ($$$1 \le i \le \min(|x|, |y|)$$$) such that $$$x_i  \lt  y_i$$$ and for all $$$j  \lt  i$$$, $$$x_j = y_j$$$.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the length of the string $$$b$$$.
The second line contains a binary string $$$b$$$ of length $$$n$$$ consisting of the characters 0 and 1.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, print the lexicographically smallest valid string $$$s$$$, or $$$-1$$$ if no such string exists.
note: In the first test case, $$$b = \texttt{10}$$$. Every substring of length $$$1$$$ must be a palindrome, and the single substring of length $$$2$$$ must not be a palindrome. The lexicographically smallest such string is $$$\texttt{ab}$$$.
In the second test case, $$$b = \texttt{001}$$$. Since $$$b_1 = 0$$$ but a single character is always a palindrome, no valid string exists, so the answer is $$$-1$$$.
In the third test case, $$$b = \texttt{1111}$$$. Every substring, of every length, must be a palindrome. The lexicographically smallest such string is $$$\texttt{aaaa}$$$.

legend: 给定一个长度为 $$$n$$$ 的二进制字符串 $$$b$$$。
构造一个长度为$$$n$$$的字符串$$$s$$$，由小写英文字母组成，使得每个$$$i$$$ ($$$1 \le i \le n$$$)：
如果$$$b_i = 0$$$，则至少有一个长度为$$$i$$$的$$$s$$$子串不是回文。
打印字典顺序最小的$$$^{\text{‡}}$$$，例如字符串$$$s$$$。如果不存在这样的字符串，打印$$$-1$$$。
$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$ 一个字符串 $$$x$$$ 是一个字符串 $$$y$$$ 的子字符串，如果 $$$x$$$ 可以通过从 $$$y$$$ 中删除几个 (可能是零个或所有) 字符和从末尾删除几个 (可能是零个或全部) 字符来获得。例如，bc、abc 和 d 是 abcd 的子字符串，而 ac 和 ba 不是。
$$$^{\text{†}}$$$如果一个字符串从左到右和从右到左读起来是一样的，那么它就是回文。换句话说，字符串的反向与原始字符串相同。例如，a、aba和abba是回文，而ab和abc不是回文。
$$$^{\text{‡}}$$$ 如果 $$$x$$$ 是 $$$y$$$ 的正前缀，或者存在一个 $$$i$$$($$$1 \le i \le \min(|x|, |y|)$$$) 位置，使得 $$$x_i  \lt  y_i$$$ 和所有 $$$j  \lt  i$$$ 都是 $$$x_j = y_j$$$，则字符串 $$$x$$$ 在词法上小于字符串 $$$y$$$。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$）——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数$$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$）——字符串$$$b$$$的长度。
第二行包含一个长度为 $$$n$$$ 的二进制字符串 $$$b$$$，由字符 0 和 1 组成。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$n$$$ 之和不超过 $$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，打印词典中最小的有效字符串 $$$s$$$，如果不存在这样的字符串，则打印 $$$-1$$$。
note: 在第一个测试用例中，是 $$$b = \texttt{10}$$$。每个长度为 $$$1$$$ 的子串必须是回文，而单个长度为 $$$2$$$ 的子串不能是回文。这种字典上最小的子串是 $$$\texttt{ab}$$$。
在第二个测试用例中$$$b = \texttt{001}$$$。因为$$$b_1 = 0$$$但一个字符总是一个回文，没有有效的字符串存在，所以答案是$$$-1$$$。

problems.hint: Strategy.

legend: Alice and Bob play a game with strings.
Each game starts with Alice choosing a string $$$A$$$ of length $$$n$$$ consisting only of the characters 'H' and 'T' and revealing it to Bob.
The rest of the game is played according to the following procedure, in order:
Bob chooses a string $$$B$$$ of length $$$n$$$ consisting only of the characters 'H' and 'T', such that $$$A \ne B$$$ and reveals the string to Alice.
Now Alice and Bob build a new string $$$S$$$ consisting only of the characters 'H' and 'T'. Bob chooses the first character of $$$S$$$.
Then Alice keeps appending a new character ('H' or 'T') to $$$S$$$ until the game ends.
The game ends immediately when one of the following occurs:
If $$$A$$$ appears as a substring$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$ of $$$S$$$, then Alice wins.
If $$$B$$$ appears as a substring of $$$S$$$, then Bob wins.
If the length of $$$S$$$ becomes $$$10^{100}$$$, then Bob wins.
Both players know the rules of the game, and every action is immediately visible to both players.
Now, Alice has already chosen the string $$$A$$$ and revealed it. Given $$$n$$$ and $$$A$$$, determine the winner if both players play optimally from this point onward.

$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$A string $$$a$$$ is a substring of a string $$$b$$$ if $$$a$$$ can be obtained from $$$b$$$ by deleting several (possibly zero) characters from the beginning and several (possibly zero) characters from the end.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)  — the number of games. The description of the games follows.
The first line of each game contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$)  — the length of the strings.
The second line contains the string $$$A$$$ of length $$$n$$$, consisting only of the characters 'H' and 'T'  — Alice's chosen string.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all games does not exceed $$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each game, output a single line containing Alice if Alice wins, and Bob otherwise.
note: In the first game, $$$A = {}$$$"HT". Bob can choose $$$B = {}$$$"TH" and set the first character of $$$S$$$ to 'T'. After that, no matter how Alice appends the remaining characters, Bob is guaranteed to win.

legend: 爱丽丝和鲍勃在玩一个用绳子的游戏。
游戏的其余部分按照以下顺序进行:
Bob 选择了一个长度为 $$$n$$$ 的字符串 $$$B$$$，其中只包含字符 ‘H’ 和 ‘T’，因此是 $$$A \ne B$$$，并将这个字符串展示给 Alice。
然后 Alice 会不断地给 $$$S$$$ 添加新的角色 (‘H’ 或 ‘T’)，直到游戏结束。
当出现以下情况之一时，游戏立即结束：
如果$$$A$$$作为$$$S$$$的子字符串$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$出现，那么Alice获胜。
如果 $$$S$$$ 的长度变成 $$$10^{100}$$$，那么 Bob 就赢了。
双方玩家都知道游戏规则，每个动作都是一目了然的。
$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$如果$$$a$$$可以通过从$$$b$$$中删除开头的几个字符(可能为零）和末尾的几个字符(可能为零）来获得，则字符串$$$a$$$是字符串$$$b$$$的子字符串。
input: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)——游戏的数量。游戏的描述如下。
每个游戏的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$)——字符串的长度。
第二行包含长度为$$$n$$$的字符串$$$A$$$，仅由字符“ H ”和“ T ”组成—Alice选择的字符串。
保证所有博弈的$$$n$$$之和不超过$$$3 \cdot 10^5$$$。
output: 对于每个游戏，如果Alice获胜，则输出包含Alice的单行，否则输出包含Bob的单行。

problems.hint: For each $v$ , which nodes can send signals to it?

legend: Usopp and Robin are analyzing a massive island shaped like a rooted tree with $$$n$$$ vertices. The root is vertex 1. Each branch (edge) connecting the vertices has an integer value representing the wind speed, and each vertex $$$v$$$ has a wind tolerance $$$k_{v}$$$.

Usopp can shoot a signal flare from a vertex $$$u$$$ to a descendant $$$v$$$ if the difference between the maximum and minimum wind speeds (edge values) on the path from $$$u$$$ to $$$v$$$ is at most the receiver's tolerance $$$k_{v}$$$:
max(w on the path from u to v) - min(w on the path from u to v) $$$\le k_{v}$$$.
Robin notes that the tolerance used here belongs to the receiver $$$v$$$, not to the sender $$$u$$$.
If $$$u=v$$$, the path contains zero edges. In this case, the difference is defined as 0, so every vertex can successfully receive a signal from itself.
For every vertex $$$u$$$, find how many descendants ($$$u$$$ included) can receive a signal from $$$u$$$.
Note: a descendant of $$$u$$$ is any node $$$v$$$ in the subtree of $$$u$$$, including node $$$u$$$
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^{4}$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \times 10^{5}$$$) — the number of vertices in the rooted tree. The root is vertex 1.
The second line of each test case contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$k_{1}, k_{2}, \dots, k_{n}$$$ ($$$0 \le k_{i} \le 10^{9}$$$) — the tolerance of each vertex.

For each $$$i$$$ from 2 to $$$n$$$, the next line contains two integers $$$p_{i}$$$ and $$$w_{i}$$$ ($$$1 \le p_{i}  \lt  i$$$, $$$0 \le w_{i} \le 10^{9}$$$) — the parent of vertex $$$i$$$ and the wind speed value on the edge between $$$p_{i}$$$ and $$$i$$$.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \times 10^{5}$$$.
output: For each test case, output $$$n$$$ integers on a single line. The $$$u$$$-th integer must be the number of descendants that can receive a signal from vertex $$$u$$$.
note: Vertex 1 reaches itself, vertex 2, and vertex 3. It does not reach vertex 4, because the values on the path to vertex 4 are 5 and 6, and their difference is greater than $$$k_{4}=0$$$.

legend: 如果从 $$$u$$$ 到 $$$v$$$ 的路径上最大和最小风速 (边值) 之间的差异最大不超过接收器的容差 $$$k_{v}$$$，则 Usopp 可以从顶点 $$$u$$$ 向后代 $$$v$$$ 发射信号闪光弹：
最大(从U到V的路径上的W）-最小(从U到V的路径上的W）$$$\le k_{v}$$$。
Robin注意到这里使用的容差属于接收方$$$v$$$，而不是发送方$$$u$$$。
如果 $$$u=v$$$，则路径包含零条边。在这种情况下，差值定义为 0，因此每个顶点都能成功接收到来自自己的信号。
对于每个顶点$$$u$$$，找出有多少后代(包括$$$u$$$）可以接收来自$$$u$$$的信号。
注意:$$$u$$$ 的后代是 $$$u$$$ 子树中的任何节点 $$$v$$$，包括节点 $$$u$$$。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^{4}$$$）——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数$$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \times 10^{5}$$$）——根树中的顶点数。根是顶点1。
每个测试用例的第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 整数 $$$k_{1}, k_{2}, \dots, k_{n}$$$($$$0 \le k_{i} \le 10^{9}$$$)——每个顶点的容差。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$n$$$ 之和不超过 $$$2 \times 10^{5}$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，在一行上输出$$$n$$$个整数。第$$$u$$$个整数必须是可以从顶点$$$u$$$接收信号的后代数。
note: 顶点1到达自身、顶点2和顶点3。它没有到达顶点4，因为到顶点4的路径上的值是5和6，并且它们的差值大于$$$k_{4}=0$$$。

problems.hint: Top $k$ for each position.

legend: Sanji is cooking a brand-new recipe in the galley, but he needs the perfect ratio of ingredients. Sherbiny gives him an array $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$.
Consider all $$$2^n$$$ subsequences of the array, including the empty subsequence.

A subsequence is obtained by choosing some indices of the array and keeping the chosen elements in their original relative order. Different choices of indices are considered different subsequences, even if they produce the same sequence of values.
For a subsequence $$$b_1, b_2, \ldots, b_m$$$, define its flavor score as $$$\sum_{i=2}^{m} \gcd(b_i, b_{i-1}).$$$
We define $$$\gcd(0,0)=0$$$. The empty subsequence and every subsequence of length $$$1$$$ have a flavor score of $$$0$$$.
Sherbiny writes the flavor scores of all $$$2^n$$$ subsequences in non-increasing order. Equal scores are kept as separate entries in this order.
Sanji wants to find the $$$k$$$-th score in this order.
input: The first line contains an integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n, k \le 1000$$$, $$$k \le 2^{n}$$$).
The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_{1}, a_{2}, \dots, a_{n}$$$ ($$$0 \le a_{i} \le 10^{9}$$$).
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n * k$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \times 10^{6}$$$.
output: For each test case, output one integer — the $$$k$$$-th biggest score.
note: In the first test case, the array is [4,6,2].
The subsequence [4, 6, 2] has value $$$gcd(4,6)+gcd(6,2)=2+2=4$$$.
Each of the subsequences [4, 6], [4,2], and [6, 2] has value 2.
Every other subsequence (including all subsequences of length at most 1, and the empty subsequence) has value 0.
Sorting all 8 values in non-increasing order gives 4, 2, 2, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, so the 2-nd maximum is 2.

legend: 桑吉正在厨房里烹饪一个全新的食谱，但他需要完美的配料比例。舍比尼给了他一个 $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ 阵列。
考虑数组的所有$$$2^n$$$子序列，包括空子序列。
子序列是通过选择数组的一些索引，并保持所选元素的原始相对顺序来获得的。不同的索引选择被认为是不同的子序列，即使它们产生相同的值序列。
对于子序列 $$$b_1, b_2, \ldots, b_m$$$，将其风味评分定义为 $$$\sum_{i=2}^{m} \gcd(b_i, b_{i-1}).$$$。
我们定义$$$\gcd(0,0)=0$$$。空子序列和每个长度为$$$1$$$的子序列的风味分数为$$$0$$$。
Sherbiny以非递增顺序写出所有$$$2^n$$$子序列的风味得分。相同的分数按此顺序作为单独的条目保存。
桑吉想按这个顺序找到 $$$k$$$ 的得分。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$）—测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数$$$n$$$和$$$k$$$($$$1 \le n, k \le 1000$$$，$$$k \le 2^{n}$$$）。
保证所有测试用例的$$$n * k$$$之和不超过$$$2 \times 10^{6}$$$。
note: 在第一个测试用例中，数组为 [4,6,2]。
每个其他子序列 (包括所有长度不超过 1 的子序列，以及空子序列) 的值为 0。

problems.hint: Iterate over $C$ .

legend: Brook is trying to write a beautiful, soulful new song using a long string of lyrics $$$s$$$.
Robin reads over his sheet music and suggests cutting the lyric string into three specific non-empty parts A, B, and C such that $$$A + B + C = s$$$ to create an echoing effect so that:
A is a prefix of C;
B is a suffix of C.
A and B can overlap inside C. Different cuts are counted as completely different musical arrangements. Help Robin find the number of ways to cut the string so Brook can sing his song.
input: The first line contains an integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^{4}$$$) — the number of test cases.
Each test case has one line with a string $$$s$$$ ($$$3 \le |s| \le 2 \times 10^{5}$$$). It has lowercase letters.
It is guaranteed that the sum of the lengths of $$$s$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \times 10^{5}$$$.
output: For each test case, output one integer — the number of ways to cut the string.
note: For $$$s = \texttt{aaaaaa}$$$, the valid splits are:
$$$A = \texttt{a}$$$, $$$B = \texttt{a}$$$, $$$C = \texttt{aaaa}$$$;
$$$A = \texttt{a}$$$, $$$B = \texttt{aa}$$$, $$$C = \texttt{aaa}$$$;
$$$A = \texttt{aa}$$$, $$$B = \texttt{a}$$$, $$$C = \texttt{aaa}$$$;
$$$A = \texttt{aa}$$$, $$$B = \texttt{aa}$$$, $$$C = \texttt{aa}$$$.
For $$$s = \texttt{aaaa}$$$, the valid split is $$$A = \texttt{a}$$$, $$$B = \texttt{a}$$$, and $$$C = \texttt{aa}$$$.
For $$$s = \texttt{abc}$$$, no split satisfies both conditions.

legend: 布鲁克试图用一长串歌词$$$s$$$写一首优美、深情的新歌。
Robin读了他的乐谱，并建议将歌词分成三个特定的非空部分A， B和C，这样$$$A + B + C = s$$$可以产生呼应效果，这样：
A 是 C 的前缀;
B 是 C 的后缀。
A和B可以在c里面重叠。不同的剪辑被认为是完全不同的音乐编曲。帮罗宾找出剪断绳子的几种方法这样布鲁克就可以唱歌了。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^{4}$$$）—测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例都有一行，其中包含字符串 $$$s$$$($$$3 \le |s| \le 2 \times 10^{5}$$$)。它包含小写字母。
可以保证所有测试用例的$$$s$$$长度之和不超过$$$2 \times 10^{5}$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数——截断字符串的方法的数量。
note: 对于 $$$s = \texttt{aaaaaa}$$$，有效的拆分为：
$$$A = \texttt{a}$$$, $$$B = \texttt{a}$$$, $$$C = \texttt{aaaa}$$$；
$$$A = \texttt{a}$$$, $$$B = \texttt{aa}$$$, $$$C = \texttt{aaa}$$$；
$$$A = \texttt{aa}$$$、$$$B = \texttt{a}$$$、$$$C = \texttt{aaa}$$$
$$$A = \texttt{aa}$$$, $$$B = \texttt{aa}$$$, $$$C = \texttt{aa}$$$。
对于$$$s = \texttt{aaaa}$$$，有效的分割是$$$A = \texttt{a}$$$， $$$B = \texttt{a}$$$和$$$C = \texttt{aa}$$$。
对于 $$$s = \texttt{abc}$$$，没有拆分能同时满足这两个条件。

problems.hint: Find the polynomial of each $k+1$ -sized subset.

legend: Elgoker locked the ship's treasure inside a secure safe. He encoded the master key as the constant term, $$$P(0)$$$, of a secret polynomial $$$P(x)$$$ of degree at most $$$k-1$$$. All calculations are heavily secured and evaluated modulo $$$10^{9}+7$$$.

To ensure the safe could be opened later, Elgoker distributed $$$k+2$$$ access codes to Chopper. Each access code is a coordinate pair $$$(x_{i}, y_{i})$$$, where $$$y_{i} = P(x_{i}) \pmod{10^{9}+7}$$$.

However, a mischievous monkey managed to infiltrate the ship and tampered with exactly one of the $$$k+2$$$ access codes, altering its $$$y_{i}$$$ value to a fake integer to lock everyone out. The remaining $$$k+1$$$ codes are completely untouched and lie perfectly on the original polynomial curve.
Given the $$$k+2$$$ access codes, your task is to help Chopper identify the corrupted code, discard it, and recover the master key $$$P(0) \pmod{10^{9}+7}$$$ so they can access the treasure!
input: The first line of the input contains a single integer $$$k$$$ ($$$2 \le k \le 2000$$$) indicating that Elgoker's secret polynomial $$$P(x)$$$ has a maximum degree of $$$k-1$$$.

The next $$$k+2$$$ lines each contain two integers $$$x_{i}$$$ and $$$y_{i}$$$ ($$$1 \le x_{i}  \lt  10^{9}+7$$$, $$$0 \le y_{i}  \lt  10^{9}+7$$$) — the $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ values of the $$$i$$$-th access code.
It is guaranteed that:
All $$$x_{i}$$$ are pairwise distinct.
Exactly one $$$y_{i}$$$ has been altered from its true value $$$P(x_{i}) \pmod{10^{9}+7}$$$.
The original polynomial $$$P(x)$$$ has degree $$$ \le k-1$$$.
output: Print a single integer: the original master key $$$P(0) \pmod{10^{9}+7}$$$.
note: In the example, the threshold is $$$k=2$$$, meaning Elgoker's polynomial has a degree of at most 1 (it is a linear equation).
The true polynomial is $$$P(x)=5x+10 \pmod{10^{9}+7}$$$.
The actual valid access codes should be: $$$P(1)=15$$$, $$$P(2)=20$$$, $$$P(3)=25$$$, $$$P(4)=30$$$.

The third access code (3, 99) was tampered with by the monkey. After discarding it, the remaining valid codes (1, 15), (2, 20), and (4, 30) perfectly form the line $$$P(x)=5x+10$$$. The master key $$$P(0)$$$ is 10.

legend: 埃尔戈克将船上的宝藏锁在一个安全的保险箱中。他将主钥匙编码为常数项 $$$P(0)$$$，其次数最多为 $$$k-1$$$ 次的秘密多项式 $$$P(x)$$$。所有计算都经过严格保密，并以 $$$10^{9}+7$$$ 模进行评估。
为了确保保险箱稍后可以打开，Elgoker 向 Chopper 分发了 $$$k+2$$$ 访问代码。每个访问代码都是一个坐标对 $$$(x_{i}, y_{i})$$$，其中 $$$y_{i} = P(x_{i}) \pmod{10^{9}+7}$$$。
然而，一只顽皮的猴子设法潜入飞船，篡改了其中一个$$$k+2$$$的访问密码，将其$$$y_{i}$$$的值更改为一个假整数，将所有人都锁在了外面。其余的$$$k+1$$$代码完全未受影响，并完美地位于原始多项式曲线上。
input: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 $$$k$$$($$$2 \le k \le 2000$$$)，表明 Elgoker 的秘密多项式 $$$P(x)$$$ 的最大次数为 $$$k-1$$$。
保证:
所有$$$x_{i}$$$都是两两不同的。
正好有一个 $$$y_{i}$$$ 被改变了其真实值 $$$P(x_{i}) \pmod{10^{9}+7}$$$。
原多项式$$$P(x)$$$的次为$$$ \le k-1$$$。
output: 打印单个整数：原始主密钥$$$P(0) \pmod{10^{9}+7}$$$。
note: 在本例中，阈值为$$$k=2$$$，这意味着Elgoker多项式的度数最多为1(它是一个线性方程）。
第三个访问代码(3，99）被猴子篡改了。在丢弃它之后，剩余的有效代码(1，15）、(2，20）和(4，30）完美地形成行$$$P(x)=5x+10$$$。主密钥$$$P(0)$$$为10。

legend: Zoro has somehow gotten completely lost again, this time on a flat island with $$$n$$$ landmarks. Sanji is furious and tries to guide him using a map. The $$$i$$$-th landmark is at $$$(x_{i}, y_{i})$$$.

To make things easier for Zoro's terrible sense of direction, Sanji decides to erase up to two landmarks from the map. The "lost diameter" of the map is the biggest Manhattan distance between any two remaining landmarks.
The Manhattan distance between $$$(x_{1}, y_{1})$$$ and $$$(x_{2}, y_{2})$$$ is $$$|x_{1}-x_{2}| + |y_{1}-y_{2}|$$$. If less than two landmarks are left, the diameter is 0.
Find the smallest possible lost diameter Sanji can achieve after removing at most two landmarks.
input: The first line contains an integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^{4}$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \times 10^{5}$$$) — the number of points.
Each of the next $$$n$$$ lines contains two integers $$$x_{i}$$$ and $$$y_{i}$$$ ($$$-10^{9} \le x_{i}, y_{i} \le 10^{9}$$$).
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \times 10^{5}$$$.
output: For each test case, output one integer — the smallest possible diameter.
note: In the first test case, remove (10,0) and (0,10). Only one point remains, so the diameter is 0.
In the second test case, after removing two opposite corners, the remaining two points can have Manhattan distance 2.

legend: 为了便于佐罗糟糕的方向感，桑吉决定从地图上删除最多两个地标。地图上 “缺失的直径” 是剩余两个地标之间最大的曼哈顿距离。
找到 Sanji 在最多移除两个地标后所能达到的最小可能损失直径。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^{4}$$$）—测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 2 \times 10^{5}$$$)——即点的数量。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$n$$$ 之和不超过 $$$2 \times 10^{5}$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数——可能的最小直径。
note: 在第一个测试用例中，移除 (10,0) 和 (0,10)。只剩下一个点，因此直径为 0。
在第二个测试案例中，去掉两个相对的角后，剩下的两个点的曼哈顿距离为2。

legend: Luffy and Zoro are exploring a ruined island containing a row of $$$n$$$ ancient stone towers. The height of the tower at position $$$i$$$ is $$$a_i$$$.
For each query $$$[l,r]$$$, consider only the towers whose positions are between $$$l$$$ and $$$r$$$, inclusive. Towers outside this segment do not affect the query.

The destruction happens in rounds. In each round, a remaining tower at position $$$i$$$ crumbles if there exist two other remaining towers at positions $$$j$$$ and $$$k$$$ such that $$$l \le j  \lt  i  \lt  k \le r$$$ and $$$a_j \gt a_i$$$ and $$$a_k \gt a_i$$$.
In other words, a tower crumbles if there is at least one strictly taller remaining tower somewhere to its left and at least one strictly taller remaining tower somewhere to its right.
The towers at positions $$$j$$$ and $$$k$$$ do not need to be adjacent to the tower at position $$$i$$$. Any remaining towers on its left and right may satisfy the condition.
All towers satisfying the condition are removed simultaneously. The process is repeated until an entire round passes without any tower crumbling.
For each query, determine how many towers in the segment $$$[l,r]$$$ remain after the process ends.
input: The first line contains an integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^{4}$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$q$$$ ($$$1 \le n, q \le 2 \times 10^{5}$$$) — the number of towers and the number of queries.
The second line contains $$$n$$$ distinct integers $$$a_{1}, a_{2}, \dots, a_{n}$$$ ($$$1 \le a_{i} \le 10^{9}$$$) — the heights of the towers.
Each of the next $$$q$$$ lines contains two integers $$$l$$$ and $$$r$$$ ($$$1 \le l \le r \le n$$$) — the segment for the query.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ and the sum of $$$q$$$ over all test cases do not exceed $$$2 \times 10^{5}$$$.
output: For each query, output one integer — the number of towers that stay standing in the segment $$$[l, r]$$$.
note: For the first query, towers with heights 1, 3, and 2 disappear in the first round. The towers with heights 4 and 5 remain.
For the second query, only 2 is removed.

legend: 路飞和佐罗正在探索一座废弃的岛屿，岛上有一排$$$n$$$古老的石塔。塔在$$$i$$$处的高度为$$$a_i$$$。
对于每个查询 $$$[l,r]$$$，只考虑位置在 $$$l$$$ 和 $$$r$$$ 之间的车，包括这些车。此段之外的车不会影响查询。
破坏分轮进行。在每轮中，如果在 $$$j$$$ 和 $$$k$$$ 位置还有另外两个剩余的塔，使得 $$$l \le j  \lt  i  \lt  k \le r$$$、$$$a_j \gt a_i$$$ 和 $$$a_k \gt a_i$$$，则 $$$i$$$ 位置的一个剩余塔将崩溃。
换句话说，如果一个塔的左边至少有一个更高的塔，右边至少有一个更高的塔，那么这个塔就会崩溃。
位于 $$$j$$$ 和 $$$k$$$ 位置的塔不需要与位于 $$$i$$$ 位置的塔相邻。其左侧和右侧的任何剩余塔都可以满足该条件。
所有符合条件的塔将同时被移除。重复这个过程，直到整个循环结束，没有任何塔倒塌。
对于每个查询，确定在进程结束后，分段 $$$[l,r]$$$ 中还剩多少个塔。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^{4}$$$）—测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$q$$$($$$1 \le n, q \le 2 \times 10^{5}$$$)——塔的数量和查询的数量。
接下来的每一行 $$$q$$$ 都包含两个整数 $$$l$$$ 和 $$$r$$$($$$1 \le l \le r \le n$$$)——即查询的段落。
保证所有测试用例的$$$n$$$和$$$q$$$之和不超过$$$2 \times 10^{5}$$$。
output: 对于每个查询，输出一个整数——保持在 $$$[l, r]$$$ 区段中的塔的数量。
note: 对于第一个查询，高度为1、3和2的塔在第一轮中消失。高度为4和5的塔楼保留了下来。
对于第二个查询，只删除了2。

problems.hint: Queries should have something to do with each other.

legend: This is an interactive problem. Refer to the Interaction Protocol section below for better understanding.

Sherbiny has hidden a secret permutation $$$p$$$ of length $$$n$$$ (an array containing every integer from 1 to $$$n$$$ exactly once). Luffy's task is to reconstruct this permutation using at most $$$n-1$$$ queries.

Luffy cannot see the elements of $$$p$$$, but he can ask Sherbiny to evaluate specific subsets of indices. When Luffy queries a subset, Sherbiny isolates the elements at those indices—keeping them in their original relative order—and tells Luffy exactly how many inversions exist just among those isolated elements.

Formal Query Definition: Specifically, if Luffy queries a subset of $$$k$$$ indices $$$1 \le i_{1}  \lt  i_{2}  \lt  \dots  \lt  i_{k} \le n$$$, Sherbiny constructs a new sequence $$$a = [p_{i_{1}}, p_{i_{2}}, \dots, p_{i_{k}}]$$$. Sherbiny then returns the total number of inversions in $$$a$$$.
The number of inversions in an array is the number of pairs of indices $$$u, v$$$ such that $$$u  \lt  v$$$ and $$$a_{u}  \gt  a_{v}$$$.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 100$$$) — the number of test cases. The description of the test cases follows.
For each test case, Sherbiny first outputs a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 1000$$$) — the length of the hidden permutation.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 1000.
output: For each test case, after at most $$$n-1$$$ questions, output one line:
For each test case, after reading $$$n$$$, you may ask at most $$$n-1$$$ questions before you must output your guess.
To ask a question, output a line in the following format:
After each question, read one integer from the judge — the number of inversions among the values at the chosen positions.
After printing each line, flush the output. For example:
cout « endl or fflush(stdout) in C++;
System.out.flush() in Java;
sys.stdout.flush() in Python.
When you have determined the hidden permutation, output a single line:
note: In the example, the judge first sends $$$t = 2$$$. The hidden permutations are $$$[3, 1, 2]$$$ in the first test case and $$$[2, 1]$$$ in the second test case.

In the first test case, $$$n = 3$$$ and the hidden permutation is $$$[3, 1, 2]$$$. The question ? 2 1 3 asks about positions $$$1$$$ and $$$3$$$, whose values are $$$3$$$ and $$$2$$$; there is one inversion because $$$3  \gt  2$$$, so the judge replies with $$$1$$$. The question ? 2 2 3 asks about positions $$$2$$$ and $$$3$$$, whose values are $$$1$$$ and $$$2$$$; there are no inversions, so the judge replies with $$$0$$$. The participant then outputs ! 3 1 2.

In the second test case, $$$n = 2$$$ and the hidden permutation is $$$[2, 1]$$$. The question ? 2 1 2 selects both positions; the values $$$2$$$ and $$$1$$$ form one inversion, so the judge replies with $$$1$$$. The participant outputs ! 2 1.
Note that the participant uses only $$$2 = n - 1$$$ questions in the first test case and $$$1 = n - 1$$$ question in the second test case.
Empty lines in the example input and output are shown only for readability. Your solution must not output blank lines.

legend: 这是一个互动的问题。为了更好地理解，请参考下面的交互协议部分。
Sherbyny 隐藏了一个长度为 $$$n$$$ 的秘密排列 $$$p$$$(一个包含从 1 到 $$$n$$$ 每个整数一次的数组)。Luffy 的任务是使用最多 $$$n-1$$$ 查询来重建这个排列。
Luffy 看不到 $$$p$$$ 的元素，但他可以让 Sherbiny 评估指数的特定子集。当 Luffy 查询一个子集时，Sherbiny 会将这些指数的元素孤立起来——保持它们原始的相对顺序——并准确地告诉 Luffy 在这些孤立的元素之间存在多少个反演。
正式查询定义：具体来说，如果Luffy查询一个$$$k$$$索引子集$$$1 \le i_{1}  \lt  i_{2}  \lt  \dots  \lt  i_{k} \le n$$$， Sherbiny构造一个新的序列$$$a = [p_{i_{1}}, p_{i_{2}}, \dots, p_{i_{k}}]$$$。然后Sherbiny返回$$$a$$$中的反转总数。
数组中的逆序数是索引对$$$u, v$$$的数目，使得$$$u  \lt  v$$$和$$$a_{u}  \gt  a_{v}$$$。
input: 对于每个测试用例，Sherbini 首先输出一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$2 \le n \le 1000$$$)——隐藏排列的长度。

每个问题之后，从裁判那里读出一个整数——所选位置的值之间的反演次数。

在c++中调用endl或fflush(stdout)；

第二个测试用例为$$$n = 2$$$，隐藏的排列为$$$[2, 1]$$$。问题是什么？2 1 2选择两个位置；值$$$2$$$和$$$1$$$形成一个反转，因此法官回答$$$1$$$。参与者输出！2 1。

示例输入和输出中的空行仅显示可读性。您的解决方案不得输出空行。

legend: Captain Kareem Elgoker is establishing a new pirate haven in the treacherous Algorithmic Seas. He has obtained an ancient map detailing the locations of $$$n$$$ uncharted islands. Due to the mystical properties of the ocean, each island emits a unique magnetic signature, denoted by an integer $$$a_i$$$.

The Captain must select exactly $$$k$$$ of these islands to form his secret archipelago territory. To ensure his crew can travel safely without being detected by the Royal Navy, he must connect all $$$k$$$ chosen islands into a single continuous network using hidden smuggling routes.

A smuggling route can be established between any two selected islands $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$. The "Secrecy Level" (cost) of the route between island $$$u$$$ and island $$$v$$$ is exactly the Least Significant Bit (LSB) of the absolute difference of their magnetic signatures.
Formally, the weight of the edge between $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$ is $$$LSB(\vert{}a_u - a_v\vert{})$$$.
(Note: $$$LSB(x)$$$ is the largest power of $$$2$$$ that divides $$$x$$$. For example, $$$LSB(12) = 4$$$, and $$$LSB(7) = 1$$$.)

To build a secure base, the network of islands will be connected by its Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) based on these Secrecy Levels. However, to maximize the overall obscurity of his territory, Captain Kareem wants to select the subset of $$$k$$$ islands such that the total weight of this MST is maximized.
Given the array $$$a$$$ representing the magnetic signatures of the islands, find the maximum possible weight of the MST if the Captain optimally chooses exactly $$$k$$$ islands.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$2 \le k \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the total number of islands and the number of islands Captain Kareem must select.
The second line contains $$$n$$$ distinct integers $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i  \lt  2^{30}$$$) — the magnetic signatures of the islands.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, output a single integer — the maximum possible weight of the Minimum Spanning Tree formed by choosing exactly $$$k$$$ islands.

legend: 船长必须精确选择 $$$k$$$ 这些岛屿，形成他的秘密群岛领地。为了确保他的船员能够安全航行而不被皇家海军发现，他必须通过隐蔽的走私路线将所有 $$$k$$$ 选定的岛屿连接成一个连续的网络。
走私路线可以在任意两个选定的岛屿$$$u$$$和$$$v$$$之间建立。岛屿$$$u$$$和岛屿$$$v$$$之间的路由的“保密级别”(cost）恰好是它们磁特征绝对差的最低有效位(LSB）。
形式上，$$$u$$$ 和 $$$v$$$ 之间的边的权重为 $$$LSB(\vert{}a_u - a_v\vert{})$$$。
为了建立一个安全基地，岛屿网络将根据这些保密等级由其最小生成树 (MST) 连接。然而，为了最大限度地提高其领地的整体隐蔽性，船长 Kareem 希望选择 $$$k$$$ 岛屿的子集，以使这个 MST 的总重量最大化。
给定代表岛屿磁特征的数组$$$a$$$，如果船长最优地精确选择$$$k$$$岛屿，则找出MST的最大可能重量。
input: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数$$$n$$$和$$$k$$$($$$2 \le k \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$）——岛屿总数和卡里姆船长必须选择的岛屿数量。
第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 不同的整数 $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$($$$1 \le a_i  \lt  2^{30}$$$)——岛屿的磁特征。
保证所有测试用例的$$$n$$$总和不超过$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数——通过精确选择 $$$k$$$ 岛屿形成的最小生成树的最大可能权重。
